name: Question 6
problem:
A rectangular plate of mass $\frac{4}{5}\,\text{kg}$ and uniform mass density occupies the region
$D={(x,y)\,:\,-1\le x\le 1,\,-2\le y\le 2},$
where $x$ and $y$ are measured in meters. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about a line perpendicular to $D$ at a distance of $\sqrt{2}\,\text{m}$ from a parallel line passing through its center of mass.

A rectangular plate of mass 45kg and uniform mass density occupies the region D={(x,y):−1≤x≤1,−2≤y≤2}, where x and y are measured in meters. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about a line perpendicular to D at a distance of 2m from a parallel line passing through its center of mass.

93kg⋅m2
b
4915kg⋅m2
c
165kg⋅m2
d
145kg⋅m2

4415kg⋅m2
